visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-02-21
Patient: 78-year-old man, established patient.
Chief complaint: left knee pain
History: left knee pain for 2 weeks after a twisting injury. Reports the knee catching and briefly locking.
Examination: medial joint-line tenderness, positive McMurray test, no effusion.
Assessment: suspected medial meniscal tear.
Plan: MRI of the left knee without contrast.
Signed: treating clinician. 2026-02-21.

expected.rationale: The policy says a statement that authorization was obtained is not enough without a reference number. An appeal now would rest on recollection, so the reference has to be found first.
